data.title: Ethereum eyes major breakout, targeting $15,000... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum is potentially setting up for a major breakout as it retests a multi-year resistance zone for the third time, following a period of strong accumulation support. Analysts note this pattern resembles Ethereum's 2020 setup before it surged to nearly $5,000. Fundstrat's Tom Lee highlights Ethereum's role as a future settlement platform for Wall Street and AI, predicting increased investor interest and a rally. Another analyst suggests a minor correction below $2,500 could precede a rise to $2,800, indicating potential short-term volatility before a continued upward trend.
data.author: The Daily Hodl
